user.title: Connect to AB64 gateway
user.description: Enter a name for this AC unit and the Modbus TCP gateway it's reachable through. Port is not defaulted — check your gateway's configuration (e.g. an Elfin EW11 may default to 8899, not 502).

unit.title: Find the unit-id
unit.description: Leave unit-id blank to scan unit-ids 1-63 (address 0 is skipped — it's the Modbus broadcast address and never responds) and read register 0 on each; this can take up to about a minute. Or enter a specific unit-id to verify it directly, including 0 — if your AB64 is set to address 0, change the DIP switch, since it will never respond on that address. Do not trust the DIP switch reading alone.

select_unit.title: Multiple units found
select_unit.description: More than one unit-id responded on this gateway. Choose the one for this AC unit.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure AB64 connection
reconfigure.description: Change the host, port, or unit-id for this AC unit. The new values are re-verified by reading register 0 before saving.

error.cannot_connect: Could not open a TCP connection to the gateway. Check host, port, and that the gateway is reachable on the network.
error.read_timeout: Connected to the gateway, but the AB64 did not respond on this unit-id. Check wiring, baud rate, and DIP switch address.
error.no_units_found: No unit-id in the 1-63 range responded. Check wiring, baud rate, and that the gateway is bridged to the RS-485 bus.
error.all_units_already_configured: Every unit-id that responded on this gateway is already set up as another entry. Nothing new to add here.
error.already_configured: This host, port, and unit-id combination is already configured.

abort.already_configured: This host, port, and unit-id combination is already configured.

error.scan_interval_too_low: Poll interval must be at least 10 seconds — this bus may be shared with other AB64 units on the same gateway.
